question: If α and β are the roots of the equation 6x² + x - 15 = 0, where α > β, then the value of (α - β) is:
solution:
Given: 

 6x2 + x - 15 = 0

__Concept:__

If α and β are the roots of the equation, ax2 + bx + c = 0

__​Calculation:__

 6x2 + x - 15 = 0

⇒ 6x2 + 10x - 9x - 15 = 0

⇒ 2x(3x + 5) - 3(3x + 5) = 0

⇒ (2x - 3)(3x + 5) = 0

⇒ x = 3/2, -5/3

Now we will find the value of (α - β)

⇒ 3/2 - (-5/3)

⇒ 3/2 + 5/3

⇒ (9 + 10)/6

⇒19/6

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
